notes: Chandra's Embercat (M20): '{T}: Add {R}. Spend this mana only to cast an Elemental spell or a Chandra planeswalker spell.' Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). Its {R} plus the pool's {W} pays for a second Embercat (an Elemental spell, {1}{R}): the first Embercat taps.
